name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project, one of the world's largest undeveloped, fully-permitted silver-gold deposits located in the Puna region of Salta Province, northern Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in 2026 and is working toward a construction decision, positioning Diablillos as a potential major silver producer.
